summary: fix(settings): pass hasPasskey in passkey-enabled signin stories
description:
Because:

- The passkey CTA is gated on account hasPasskey, but the
  passkey-enabled Signin/SigninAlternativeAuthOptions stories only
  flipped the feature flags, so they fell back to the legacy circular
  third-party buttons with no passkey button.

This commit:

- Passes hasPasskey in all passkey-enabled Signin and
  SigninAlternativeAuthOptions stories.
- Disables the other auth options in the passkey loading story to match
  page behaviour during an in-flight ceremony.
